faq.q: How often should my furnace and AC be serviced?
faq.a: Once a year for each is the standard recommendation: the furnace in early fall and the air conditioner in spring. A tune-up catches small problems before they become breakdowns and helps the system run efficiently.

faq.q: Should I repair or replace my system?
faq.a: It depends on the age of the equipment, the cost of the repair and how efficiently it runs. Most furnaces and AC units last roughly 15 to 20 years. If yours is near the end of that range and needs a major repair, replacing it is often the better value. We'll walk you through both options.

faq.q: How often should I change my air filter?
faq.a: Standard 1-inch filters should be checked monthly and replaced every 1 to 3 months, more often with pets or allergies. Thicker media filters can last 6 to 12 months.

faq.q: What size system does my home need?
faq.a: Proper sizing depends on square footage, insulation, windows and ductwork, not just the size of the old unit. An oversized or undersized system costs more to run and wears out sooner, so we size equipment to your home.
